about_the_game:
🏋️‍♂️ Clean and Customize Your Gym

Begin with a run-down space and turn it into a premium fitness center. Choose wall colors, flooring, lighting, and more every detail is yours to personalize.

💪 Unlock and Upgrade Equipment

Start small and grow big. From basic benches to cutting-edge machines, expand your selection to meet every client’s fitness goal and keep your gym ahead of the curve.

🥊 Build a Boxing Arena

Train rising stars, host electrifying matches, and bring in the crowds. Let visitors bet on bouts to generate extra income and excitement.

🧖‍♀️ Add Premium Facilities

Install saunas, massage rooms, and wellness areas to offer a complete and luxurious experience. Happy clients stay longer and spend more.

👗 Design a Locker & Apparel Zone

Give clients a stylish and functional space to change and shop. Stock the latest activewear and turn your gym into a fitness and fashion destination.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500 @ 3,3 GHz (4 CPUs)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 670
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 @ 3,2 GHz (4 CPUs)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1060 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Gym Simulator 2 Together: Evolve Your Fitness Empire! Step into the next level of gym management. Clean, expand, customize, and dominate the fitness world with new features, facilities, and challenges.
